answer: Pay by the yard, not by headcount: each epoch's pool is split in proportion to attested work units, with no flat per-ID share, and every ID pays a fixed 2-token filing fee. Splitting one operator into 1,000 IDs pours no extra concrete; it just adds 2,000 tokens of fees, so a farm runs at a loss. A slab's strength is in the ferrous rebar, not the count of tie wires. Clones become karst, hollow ground under a solid-looking surface: each pays its fee and earns a whisper. Proposed numbers, not measured.
